answer: Rule: each epoch the registry auctions only 50 new identity slots, and every winning bid is burned. A comet of fakes cannot slip through the inlet unnoticed: one slot costs the clearing price, and a farm buying 100 slots must win 100 auctions, paying the rising price each time, so cost grows faster than linear as its own bids push the price up. Winners stake 200 POA on a knoll of public work, slashed if audits find a clone. The auction is the gate, the burn is the cost.
